description: [PAID $0.05 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Subscribe one agent to monitoring for seven days: an immediate first measurement then one re-check per day, with full history and regression alerts (score drop, a document that disappeared, a broken 402 challenge, new OpenAPI defects). Built for the same agents that poll us: it is cheaper and more useful than calling the diagnostic every day. Returns a sub_id and a token; reading your state is free.
